rationale: Preserve the whole-grid rule and all original failures/costs. Use one separately frozen fresh264-grid campaign; no borrowed rows, no cancelled-ledger resume, no source/policy/task/seed/parser/threshold/lease changes. Outer campaign identity changes; inner experimental method does not.
conditions: Independent audit of original retained records and input identities.
Review and test new campaign wrapper before launch.
Full new grid must be audited before usable paired exports.
No pooling repeated worlds as independent samples.
Any second abort is retained; no automatic retry.
clock_cause: Wall/monotonic discontinuity is supported; host suspension versus clock adjustment is not proven.
